bonus.text: At the acrobatic dance World Cup in Moscow on 23 November 2025, four young Flex Fuzion dancers faced rivals from 30 countries and earned The Gambia a 6th-place world ranking.
Lenjengo is a Mandinka dance usually performed at the end of a harvest. Its female dancers carry sawandangs, tools for separating chaff from grain once millet or maize is ground.
The Gambia’s National Troupe was set up in 1974. In 1976 it toured the Americas to promote the country as a destination, and it performed as far as Russia and Libya.
